verdict.rationale: Better Auth stores auth data in the developer's own database (SQLite/Postgres/MySQL) rather than a vendor-hosted store, and community comments emphasize 'I own all the data' and full schema control, plus docs show users can revoke their own sessions and rotate secrets — giving some data-deletion control. However there is no explicit documentation of a data retention policy, account/user deletion API, or GDPR-style erasure workflow in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit user/account deletion API docs, data retention policy statements, and compliance (e.g. GDPR/CCPA erasure) documentation.
